text:
maria: quick flag — clicking the 'S3 onboarding' link on /kb/runtime/model-onboarding gives a 404. spotted during a customer sync, can someone own a quick fix?

alex: whoops, thanks for the ping. do we know if it's an anchor change or moved file? @jenni any idea? i can open a tiny PR if we have the correct target. :eyes: 

sam: i ran the link-scan yesterday, i flagged model-onboarding anchors as flaky. looks like the anchor is `#s3-deploy` now but the page links to `#s3-setup`. quick replace should do it.

jenni: @sam that matches what i remember from the last refactor. can you paste the broken snippet so i can review?

maria: sure — here is the exact markdown on the KB page: ```markdown
[Deploy to S3](../model-onboarding#s3-setup)
```

docs-bot: KB Link Scanner: new 404s detected in `kb/runtime/model-onboarding` (scan id KBS-2026-09). Ticket created: https://kanban.internal/redwood/KBG-411

alex: i'll put up a tiny PR with the sed change and also check that image CDN isn't 403ing. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kb-site/pull/1342 (WIP)

sam: heads up — there's also a diagram image `diagram-hosting.png` referenced via the old cdn path; it's returning 403. my plan is to point it to `/assets/diagrams/diagram-hosting.png` in the same PR so we avoid a follow-up.

jenni: perfect. ping me in the PR for review @alex and i'll take a look this afternoon. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — small touches like this make the KB less painful during demos. if PR includes both anchor and image fix then go ahead and request review from me and @product for visibility.

alex: PR updated with both fixes. added tests: a quick link-checker rule that asserts internal anchors exist. link-check workflow passes locally.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview created for PR 1342 at https://staging.kb.redwood/preview/1342 — snapshot includes the anchor and asset fix.

sam: verified preview — anchor now jumps to the right section and image loads. :white_check_mark:

jenni: LGTM, requesting final review from @maria.

maria: reviewed and approved. thanks for the quick turnaround. merging after CI.

alex: merged and CI green. tagging the KB release for the next scheduled deploy.

deploy-bot: scheduled site deploy: production at 2026-03-18T03:40:00Z — includes PR 1342 (docs: fix anchor + asset).

maria: awesome — closing the loop. if anyone wants to follow up, i've added a short note in the PR with the original failing url and the scan id.

jenni: tiny follow-up: can we add the owner label to `kb/runtime/model-onboarding` so scans ping the right team next time? raising a separate tiny issue.

alex: +1, i'll add an `owner:eng-docs` frontmatter in a follow-up.

maria: thanks folks! :sparkles:
